title: The spread construction and non-uniqueness of visible Lagrangians
summary: Every even symplectic Hirzebruch surface contains a Lagrangian torus and every odd symplectic Hirzebruch surface contains a Lagrangian Klein bottle as their respective real locus. From a toric point of view, this is a visible Lagrangian which surjects to the full moment polytope under the moment map. In this paper, we prove that every Hirzebruch surface contains both a Lagrangian torus and a Lagrangian Klein bottle with this property.
